newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's makes Dominican Republic debut.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's makes Dominican Republic debut.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said it opened its first restaurant in the Dominican Republic on November 30, the ninety-ninth new country where it operates.
It was the third new country for the fast-food chain in a month. Other openings were in Jordan and Paraguay.

"We're on target with our growth strategy around the world," said Jim Cantalupo, president of McDonald's International, "And we will cap a year of unprecedented international development with our 100th country milestone on December 10."
There are more than 20,000 McDonald's outlets worldwide.
